method: Opened both actual online screenshots with view_image after the successful Pages deployment. This supplements real DOM assertions and does not review MP4 playback.
observations: 390px database series has an independent, deduplicated database breadcrumb, exactly four published lessons in original EP.15–18 order, a database learning-route link and v0.81.0 footer. Text and controls fit the narrow viewport.

1440px library has direction and series both set to database, displays 4 of 48 items, and shows the four existing database cards with loaded original covers and original episode/date identity. No systems category appears on these cards.
scope: Canonical-origin Chromium requests used ordinary urllib responses validated with the configured CA bundle; HTTPS verification remained enabled. The helper caches responses, so 71 networkResponses counts actual fetch entries rather than all browser requests. Seven MP4 Range responses were incidental browser preload and are not playback checks.
